name: ArduPilot Plane: QuadPlane frame setup
why: Motor order and prop directions for the Quad X lift layout (build step 7.2, firmware output map).

name: ArduPilot Plane: QuadPlane building guide
why: How a lift + cruise quadplane is set up in ArduPlane: transition, Q-assist and the parameters in firmware/vtol_c0.param.

name: ArduPlane firmware for the CoreWing F405 Wing V2
why: Confirms the chosen flight controller runs stable ArduPlane with QuadPlane support.

name: SunnySky X4110S motors
why: Maker page for the lift and pusher motor (165 g); its thrust table (3130 gf at 27.7 A on a 17 in prop, docs/research/budget-lift.md) drives the lift-unit choice and hover-efficiency calibration.

name: UIUC Propeller Data Site, vol. 1
why: Measured small-propeller performance (APC 10×4.7 and 10×7) used in the configuration trade study.

name: Ovonic Roam 6S 6500 mAh LiPo (maker page)
why: Maker spec for the 6500 mAh 6S pack class (144.3 Wh); the chosen 100C pair (Amazon B09CTRKLM4, 820 g) and this alternative are compared in docs/research/budget-energy-test.md.

name: Polymaker Fiberon PA6-CF20 technical data sheet
why: Print settings, annealing and heat resistance of the motor mounts and pusher cup.

name: XFOIL 6.99 (Drela, MIT)
why: 2-D section polars of the NACA 2415 wing and NACA 0009 tail at flight Reynolds numbers.

name: AVL 3.52 (Drela, MIT)
why: Vortex-lattice trim, CL_max, neutral point and control derivatives used by sizing and the SITL model.

name: SU2 8.5.0
why: RANS CFD that validates the section polars and produces the flow visualisations.

name: NeuralFoil (Sharpe)
why: Independent airfoil-polar estimate cross-checking XFOIL.

name: BETA Technologies ALIA
why: Full-scale reference for the lift + cruise layout C0 is modelled on.

name: NASA: VTOL urban air mobility concept vehicles (Silva et al.)
why: NASA lift + cruise, tilt and multirotor concept vehicles, used as configuration references in the trade study.

name: FAA: register a drone (Part 107)
why: Registration needed before flight testing (compliance checklist).

name: FAA: FAA-recognised identification areas (Remote ID)
why: Where the aircraft may fly without a Remote ID module (compliance checklist).

name: Pollet et al., fixed-wing VTOL UAV sizing (ICAS 2022)
why: Sizing equations, stopped-prop drag model and mass fractions that C0's assumptions were checked against (docs/research/benchmarks.md).

name: Mathur and Atkins, quadplane cruise-speed optimisation (arXiv 2411.08661)
why: Finds a quadplane's best cruise speed just above stall; with C0's own polar this led to the 18 m/s cruise.

name: Mathur and Atkins, quadplane wind-tunnel tests (arXiv 2301.12316)
why: Measured quadplane drag above idealised estimates and rear-rotor thrust loss in transition.

name: Drela, MIT design rules
why: Tail-volume and static-margin ranges used to check C0's tail and CG.

name: NASA NPR 7123.1D, PDR/CDR entrance and success criteria
why: The review criteria this design review is checked against (Overview, review readiness).
